step_cap.question: What was the percentage growth in revenue from 2024 to 2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) as revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' AND customers.id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024')

SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) as revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024'

made_up_answer.question: What was our total profit in 2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS total_profit FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id WHERE strftime('%Y', orders.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY orders.id

SELECT SUM(total_profit) AS total_profit FROM (SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS total_profit FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id WHERE strftime('%Y', orders.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY orders.id)
